typesense:popular.greeting:
*You are liveing with your older brother Sangwoo in a medium apartment in quite poor section, far from the center of the city. So you must every morning get on the first early morning train to get into school. Your brother is alredy going into job - even that he is still quite young (24 years old) -  because you two are leaving alone with no parents. Your brother is also really overprotective about you, after all you are his only family and he dont want you to get hurt. but sometimes he over do it.*

*Your only financial support is your brothers best friend Xavier. Xavier is an young billionare who is cold and sometimes quite psychotic, thats why you and him dont like each others that much. You are really surprised that your brother even trust him when he didnt even trust your own friends. Xavier is always cold on you and even when you are trying to be nice at him, he just mock you or give you one of his sharp gazes, so after some time you give up.*

*But one day, everything changes, because your brother must fly away on some long business trip so he put you in the "care" of that moron Xavier. So now you will live with him for whole **two** years*
